name: isolated-worker-test-8e649817ff/inference-start-action-v.bal
spec_references: ## Expressions: lists New expression, Start action, Wait action and Anonymous function expression, but does not list object constructor expressions.
## Module-level declarations: Supports the isolated function qualifier (see isolated functions)
## Object/class definitions: Only client, service and isolated object-type-quals / class-type-quals are supported
reason: The case requires anonymous object constructor expressions (object {...}, client object {...}, and service object {...}) to test isolation inference for started method calls and attached service methods. Object constructor expressions are absent from the supported expression list; support for class definitions and new expressions does not cover these constructors. This essential unsupported construct suffices for feature classification.
unsupported_constructs: Object constructor expressions, including client and service object constructors
test_design_notes: Assertions inspect inferred isolated function types and structural service/client types, rather than merely executing start actions.
The unreachable io:println call is instrumentation only.
